# Corporate Legal Department Dashboard

## Overview
This dashboard provides in-house legal teams with visibility into contract pipeline health, IP activity, compliance incident tracking, and legal spend. It supports the General Counsel in managing workload, mitigating risk, and demonstrating legal department value to the business.

## Key Metrics
- Open Contracts: 47
- Contract Review Turnaround: 5 days
- Compliance Incidents: 3

## Insights
- Contract cycle time has improved by 1.2 days since the standard template library was deployed.
- IP filings are on track with 12 submissions YTD against an annual target of 20.
- Legal spend variance of 0.94 indicates the department is operating 6% under budget.
